questions.question: Which champion will have the highest Presence (% of games picked or banned) across all drafts?
questions.method: Patch-weighted presence in recent top-tier drafts (games on the newest patch, 16.20, count 10x), with wide uncertainty because the Worlds patch reshuffles the meta, then the event's ~100 games simulated 20,000 times.
questions.why: Vi is picked or banned in 74% of recent top-tier drafts (newest-patch games weighted most), the highest of any champion. Backtested on the last four Worlds this method was right on the #1 champion only about 1 time in 12: the Worlds leader is usually a power pick from the Worlds patch itself (Aatrox went from 30% to 98% in 2022). Next: Nocturne (66%), Cassiopeia (63%).
